sources.title: Vispark public model roster
sources.evidence: Direct unauthenticated GET returned exact vispark/vision-small with Vispark ownership, 1,000,000 context, text/image/audio/video/file inputs, text output and reasoning/tools support. All three sizes share created=1715731200; this metadata does not explain variant launch history. Reopened October 27 for the parameter re-audit: the exact Small record contains no total- or active-parameter field.

sources.title: Vispark Lab model documentation and playground
sources.evidence: Read deployed index-g5phCnAo.js loaded by the current page. Vision exposes small/medium/large sizes, text/image/audio/video/PDF inputs and text output, continual-learning weights, function tools and a 1M context. Its OpenAI compatibility panel lists exact vispark/vision-small, medium and large identifiers.

sources.title: AIVOCO Vision CLv1 model family
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27: the developer homepage Model Family explicitly identifies Vision CLv1 Small as 45B, separately from Medium 175B and full 550B. The current playground link leads to Vispark Lab. This is a published nominal model total; no active count or precise component decomposition is given.

sources.title: Continual Learning Models: An Introduction to Weight Management
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 search retrieved the complete indexed original article; direct web open again timed out. Section 6 identifies three models trained from scratch, including Vision CLv1 Small 45B, and says all are available at Vispark Lab. Sections 2-3 describe modified Transformer architecture, compact learned-state inputs and inference-time updates; they do not quantify Small active parameters. The 550B base-weight example concerns the full model, not Small.

sources.title: AIVOCO model playground destination
sources.evidence: Developer playground page redirects to https://lab.vispark.in/. Together with the exact CLv1 three-size table and Lab compatibility identifiers, establishes the mapping to the current Vision Small alias, not a dated 2024 checkpoint. Fresh HTTP 200 source retrieved October 27 still contains the explicit meta-refresh and JavaScript redirect to that Lab URL.

sources.title: Vispark product timeline
sources.evidence: Read timeline in current index-BgxKNlqk.js. May 15, 2024 is the launch of generic Vision chat on vansh.one, not an individually identified Small release. Later timeline describes Lab and continual-learning upgrades without identifying the first Small deployment.

sources.title: Vision AI by Vispark: a foundational Indian multimodal AI
sources.evidence: September 1, 2025 developer article explicitly offers Vision through the Lab API in small, medium and large sizes. Establishes availability by that date, but does not state when Small was initially released. Covers media input and 1M context; its broader chat product capabilities are not treated as Small API output modes.

sources.title: Vispark Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Current deployed terms dated September 26, 2025 reserve service content, features and functionality to Vispark/licensors and restrict copying or distribution without written consent. Read alongside commercial hosted API documentation; supports descriptive proprietary access rather than an open-weight license.

sources.title: A Self-Improving Experiential AI Model: A Path to Continual Learning
sources.evidence: 2025 author paper linked by AIVOCO describes generic Vision/Experiential and uses 175B and 250B figures, but does not map them to Vision Small. Those figures, specific backbone details and the article copyright license are not transferred to this API model. Freshly retrieved PDF text was independently reread in this pass: Section 3 describes 250B while Section 3.1 calls the base 175B; neither identifies Small or an active-count convention.

sources.title: A Culturally Aware Multimodal AI Model
sources.evidence: 2024 author paper linked by AIVOCO describes a generic 175B Vision multimodal Transformer, without a Small variant. It does not establish Small parameters, precise architecture or release date. Freshly retrieved text was independently reread in this pass; the abstract and training section state 175B total for generic Vision, with no Small mapping or active-parameter count.

sources.title: Current Vispark Lab documentation bundle
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 HTTP 200 bundle independently read. Vision has small/medium/large size choices and exact OpenAI-compatible vispark/vision-small alias; native API documents continual_learning and weights inputs. No numerical Small total/active count is supplied. API request parameters and state blobs are not physical active-parameter measurements.

sources.title: Vision CLv1 original ARC-AGI-3 benchmark harness
sources.evidence: Freshly opened October 27 after following the original architecture article. README identifies the evaluated agent as Vispark/Vision Large and offers configurable size choices. It does not publish a Small total/active parameter table, so the Large benchmark and learned-state files cannot establish Small activation.

name.note: Exact public alias name, omitting the redundant provider prefix.

developer.note: Exact API owner and original publisher. Later AIVOCO pages describe the same founder and link the same Lab; retain the serving developer identity.

family.note: Small is explicitly one of the Vision sizes.

release_date.note: Clear the unsupported May 15, 2024 exact-variant date: it labels generic Vision chat and is repeated as roster creation metadata. Small is explicitly available by September 1, 2025, but its initial launch date and transition to CLv1 were not established.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is the paid hosted Lab API. Continual-learning state blobs returned to callers are combined with a hosted base model; they are not a public release of the complete base checkpoint.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the commercial hosted model and reserved service rights; no public base-model redistribution grant was found.

parameters_b.note: Fresh review confirms the developer-published nominal 45B total for CLv1 Small. The original article explicitly locates that three-size family at Vispark Lab, whose current documentation and roster identify vispark/vision-small. Earlier generic Vision 175B/250B descriptions are not this named Small generation; no structural or lineage inference is needed.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately stated Small active count was found in the freshly reopened family specifications, complete indexed architecture article, live API documentation, older original papers or the creator benchmark README. Fresh exact-model and later-paper searches found no original comparison-table convention. Total size and learned-state updates do not establish active parameters.

architecture.note: Latest author article describes the continual-learning model family as modified Transformer and explicitly includes Small. Preserve that broad architecture only; dense/MoE layout, layer counts and routing are undisclosed. Indexed primary text was available although direct retrieval timed out.

context_window.note: Exact live roster context_length is 1,000,000; the 65,536 maximum output and documented 980,000 combined input limit are separate limits.

modalities.note: Roster lists file input; exact Vision API documentation resolves supported files to PDFs. This is the API input contract; it does not independently establish how each modality is encoded internally.

reasoning.note: Exact roster declares reasoning in supported_features. This records the vendor-advertised capability; no inference call or reasoning-output behavior was tested.

tool_call.note: Exact roster advertises tools and the Small API example includes function definitions and tool-call responses.

patch.notes: AIVOCO identifies the current Vision Small alias with its later CLv1 Small model and reports a nominal 45B total. Active parameters and dense/MoE layout are undisclosed. The family is described as a modified Transformer. Small was documented by September 1, 2025; its first release date remains unresolved. Downloadable continual-learning state is not the complete hosted checkpoint.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit retains the developer-published nominal 45B total for CLv1 Small and explicitly leaves active parameters undisclosed. Reopened the current family table, live Lab identity, original architecture article and older author papers; later-research searches supplied no matched active count. Preserved the other twelve field assessments.

parameter_reaudit.outcome: Retained verified nominal total 45B; active count remains undisclosed after a fresh review.

reopened_originals.result: Independently inspected exact Small roster, deployed Lab documentation, September 2025 original launch article, current AIVOCO family specification and playground redirect. Also reopened AIVOCO and Vispark original pages through web access during this pass.

older_papers.result: Original 2024 generic Vision175B and 2025 Experiential175B/250B descriptions do not identify Small; neither establishes its active count.

searches: "Vispark" "Vision Small" parameters technical report benchmark; "Vision CLv1" "active parameters"; "Vision CLv1" "activated" parameters; site:arxiv.org "Vispark" "Vision" parameters
Exact original weight-management article plus Architecture, active/activated/expert; "Vision CLv1 Small" parameters benchmark paper
parameter_reaudit.fresh_original_article: Full original indexed text retrieved October 27, including Sections 2-4 and 6. Direct retrieval again timed out; current homepage independently corroborates 45B and the original article explicitly maps the family to Vispark Lab.
parameter_reaudit.later_research_review: The linked original ARC-AGI-3 harness README identifies Vision Large and supplies no Small active count. Bounded fresh searches returned provider directories or unrelated Vision models rather than an exact original active-parameter comparison.
parameter_reaudit.limitations: No Small active-parameter disclosure or original research convention was established. Do not infer activation from the nominal total, Transformer label or adaptation state; do not transfer generic older Vision or current Large counts. No weight shards were downloaded.
